QuestInfo.name: [Heroes] Two Flashy Heroes
QuestInfo.0: The path leads into the ruins. What's waiting inside?
QuestInfo.1: You defeated Kapus the Gatekeeper on the path that leads into the ruins.
QuestInfo.2: The two heroes, Phantom and Luminous, made a fantastic entrance at a critical point! They're strong and reliable. Too bad they can't get along.
